global: This shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth with tender chashu pork and crisp menma. Garnished with bean sprouts and green onions, it sits in a blue-and-white patterned bowl, warmly lit against a wooden table.

regions.background: Light wood grain table surface with visible texture and natural wood coloration.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with blue geometric patterned rim, smooth glossy surface, circular shape.
regions.soup: The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is golden-brown, clear, and glossy, with thin noodles and toppings floating on its surface.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows white meat, thin fat layer, and green onion garnish on its surface.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, thin, and slightly translucent with visible fibrous texture and green onion garnish on top.
